purpose: Preserve every null/inconclusive outcome with a mechanistic explanation so future agents cannot accidentally re-run a null as if it were unexplored, and so the negative results remain scientifically usable.

negative_results.outcome: C2 funding-conditioned vs B1 RV-only on 24h forward RV
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: Adding funding terms to an RV-only baseline did not improve 24h forward RV QLIKE; the improvement was negative and not significant after Holm correction. RV persistence dominates; funding adds no incremental 24h-horizon volatility skill.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: RV-only baseline is strong at 24h horizon; do not re-run time-series 24h RV C2-vs-B1 on this panel.

negative_results.outcome: pooled within-hour cross-sectional funding contrast on RV
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: Pooled across all regimes, the funding effect on next-hour RV is indistinguishable from zero. The effect only emerges once the sample is conditioned on the RV regime (see XSEC-002).
negative_results.reusable_lesson: Do not pool across RV regimes when testing funding->RV; regime conditioning is necessary.

negative_results.outcome: out-of-sample forward confirmation of FCLR-011 RV forecast gate
negative_results.statistic: pooled C2 vs B1 mean diff +0.026760, CI [0.000343, 0.064822] favouring B1, rel -5.55%, n=10200, 85 days
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: The FCLR-011 sealed PASS (4.94% QLIKE improvement on 2026-05..2026-08) did not generalize to the 2026-08..2026-10 forward window; C2 was significantly worse than B1 out-of-sample. The sealed PASS does not constitute generalizable skill.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: A sealed in-window PASS is not evidence of forward skill. Always require out-of-sample forward confirmation.

negative_results.outcome: cross-panel reconciliation: RV tercile regime vs UTC session bucket
negative_results.statistic: Primary A high-RV CI [-0.0004, 2.005] incl. 0 (p=0.272, Holm 0.816); Primary B pass; joint gate needs both
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: The two conditioning schemes (RV tercile vs UTC session) do not reconcile into a single coherent mechanism: the RV-tercile-based Primary A contrast includes zero, so the joint gate (requiring both) fails even though the UTC-bucket Primary B passes.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: RV-tercile and UTC-session conditioning are not interchangeable; do not assume a single regime variable explains both panels.

negative_results.statistic: Primary A passes with sign reversal vs XSEC-002; Primary B fails; joint gate NOT_SUPPORTED
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: An alternative regime variable (volatility-of-volatility) produces a Primary A result with the opposite sign to the RV-tercile result (XSEC-002), and Primary B fails. The funding effect is not robust to the choice of regime variable.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: Funding-conditioning results are regime-variable-dependent and not robust across alternative conditioning schemes; the XSEC program is terminal.

negative_results.outcome: out-of-sample forecast of next-24h observed notional-weighted liquidation intensity (C2 vs B1)
negative_results.statistic: QLIKE FAIL rel -5.88% CI incl. zero materiality not met; Brier PASS +11.48%; LogLoss PASS +8.63%; joint gate requires ALL -> NOT_SUPPORTED
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: C2 (RV+funding+premium+ema) did not improve the continuous QLIKE intensity forecast out-of-sample (relative reduction -5.88%, CI includes zero). It did improve the binary Brier/LogLoss classification, but the joint gate requires ALL three metrics, so the honest verdict is NOT_SUPPORTED. The funding-conditioned signal is detectable in classification but not in continuous intensity magnitude out-of-sample.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: Funding conditioning may carry binary liquidation-risk signal but not continuous intensity-magnitude skill. Do not conflate classification improvement with forecast skill.

negative_results.outcome: time-series 24h liquidation intensity C2 vs B1
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: Time-series (non-cross-sectional) funding-conditioned liquidation intensity forecast did not meet the QLIKE gate.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: Time-series liquidation intensity forecasting is not viable on this panel; cross-sectional regime-conditioned contrasts are the only SUPPORTED liquidation associations.

negative_results.outcome: funding-conditioned forecast of modeled synthetic boundary breaches
negative_results.statistic: pooled Log Loss B1=0.292447 -> C2=0.287540 = +1.68% (<2% floor); CI [-0.010997, 0.003094] crosses zero; only 2 non-overlapping 30-day blocks (<3)
negative_results.mechanistic_explanation: Even on modeled synthetic boundary breaches (a proxy, NOT observed liquidations), the funding-conditioned improvement was below the 2% materiality floor and not significant, with insufficient independent blocks. The risk overlay is INELIGIBLE.
negative_results.reusable_lesson: Modeled boundary breaches are a weaker proxy than observed liquidations; do not promote Track B results to observed-liquidation claims.

inconclusive_or_blocked.explanation: Track A observed-liquidation extension did not pass; combined with the frozen-panel frontier exhaustion, no new Track A confirmatory design is feasible without new data.
No contiguous or disjoint 3-block design is feasible on the frozen Binance mark+funding data or the Hyperliquid bulk/extended frontiers. See frontier_exhaustion_audit_20261121T080000Z.

preservation_guarantee: All negative results above are preserved verbatim with their exact statistics and mechanistic explanations. They are NOT to be re-run as if unexplored. The honest null NOT_SUPPORTED verdicts are preserved; no 2% materiality floor was relaxed after seeing outcomes.
